scenes.texte: Your AI answers are vague? Your prompt probably is too. Like this one: write a presentation about climate change.

carte.texte: Write a presentation about climate change.

scenes.texte: You get an answer that is generic, far too long, and not made for your level.
Give it four things instead: a role, a goal, an audience, and a format.
Here is the same request, made clear. Now the answer is focused and useful.

carte.texte: You are a geography teacher. Outline a 5-minute presentation on climate change for high-school students, in 3 parts, with one real example per part.

scenes.texte: Thirty prompts like this one are in the guide Thirty Practical AI Prompts, for four dollars ninety-nine. Comment GUIDE.
